title: Proximal Limited-Memory Quasi-Newton Methods for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: We introduce a proximal limited--memory quasi--Newton scheme for minimizing the sum of a continuously differentiable function and a proper, lower semicontinuous and prox-bounded, possibly nonsmooth, function. Both functions might be nonconvex. The method builds upon the computation of scaled proximal operators and is globalized by adaptively updating a regularization parameter based on a criterion of sufficient decrease.
